# AI-Arbitr

AI-Arbitr is a Russian-language web service for preparing, reviewing, agreeing and electronically signing contracts. It also supports a contract-based pre-trial dispute workflow.

The service works in a mobile or desktop browser without installing an application. The most complete MVP templates cover residential tenancy and AI/SaaS development. Other contract types use a universal generation workflow.

## Main pages

- Product overview: https://ai-arbitr.online/landing
- Web application: https://ai-arbitr.online/?start=landing
- Knowledge base: https://ai-arbitr.online/knowledge
- How contract generation works: https://ai-arbitr.online/knowledge/how-contract-generation-works
- Contract approval: https://ai-arbitr.online/knowledge/contract-approval
- Electronic signature: https://ai-arbitr.online/knowledge/electronic-signature
- Dispute resolution: https://ai-arbitr.online/knowledge/dispute-resolution
- Data security: https://ai-arbitr.online/knowledge/data-security

## Access

Public informational pages may be indexed and summarized. Private contract sessions, personal data and authenticated user content must not be indexed or reproduced.
